family_definition.rule: one suite crossed with one compared dimension, closed at analysis time: every comparison this invocation declared, which must include every comparison of the family's current record, so a family only grows and each growth is a new record superseding the old by id (PRD Methodology 24)

members.observation_reason: the sides do not differ on the compared dimension's key field(s) prompt_variant_id, prompt_variant_version

conventions.exact_rule: exact two-sided p from all 2^m sign assignments over the observed tie-averaged ranks when the non-zero count m is at most the threshold; normal approximation above it, with Cureton's zero adjustment and the tie correction
conventions.zero_method_definition: zero differences are ranked with the others, then their ranks are excluded from W+ and W-

result.effect_size_formula: (W+ - W-) / (W+ + W-), over the ranks of the non-zero differences
result.statistic_name: W+: the sum of the ranks of positive differences

members.test_chosen_because: the compared quantity is a continuous per-item measurement (tokens or an engine-reported first-token time): per-item differences carry magnitude and no normality is assumed, so the Wilcoxon signed-rank test ranks them

multiplicity_correction.adjusted_over: every member that was not refused, tests and observations alike, so adjustment_size equals tested_count; a member whose p is left null with a named reason enters as p = 1, which never lowers another member's adjusted p, and keeps its own adjusted p null with that reason; a refused member carries no p and enters no count
multiplicity_correction.formula: adjusted p_(i) = max over j <= i of min(1, (m - j + 1) * p_(j)), the m raw p-values sorted ascending; computed exactly, so tied raw p-values share one adjusted value and with m = 1 the adjusted p equals the raw p

verdict_rule: distinguishable when the Holm-adjusted p over the family (adjusted_p_value) <= alpha; not distinguishable otherwise, including a p left null because the sides never disagree; not comparable for a refusal, an observation (the sides differ outside the compared dimension or not on it, so no difference is attributable to it; its p stays in result) or a paired n below the test's minimum
